question: Which month will have the highest officially reported TSMC consolidated net revenue among September, October, and November 2026?

calls.reasoning: September 2026 came in at NT$511.857B, down 0.6% from August's record NT$514.806B. Analysts (BofA, Morgan Stanley) expect fourth-quarter revenue up 10-15% over the third quarter's NT$1.494T, about NT$548-573B per month. September can only win if fourth-quarter revenue falls below the third quarter, so it gets little weight. Between October and November, October won in 4 of the 8 years from 2018 to 2025 (2018, 2023, 2024, 2025, including the last three AI-era years), November in 2 (2019, 2022) and September in 2 (2020, 2021). Monthly revenue swings with wafer shipment timing, so November keeps substantial weight. No human market was found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers. Official fourth-quarter guidance comes out on October 15, after this forecast.
